points: 718 firms, about 726,000 workers, Jellyfish data from January 2021 to March 2026
Agents raise lines of code by about 30%, but resolved Jira issues show no significant change (gains above 12% ruled out)
Time from pull request to merge rises 3.45 days on a 7.03-day baseline, up 49%
read: Chen and Stratton, 'Artificial Intelligence in the Firm: Bottlenecks in Software Production', Harvard job-market paper (version 4 August 2026)
take: Large-sample evidence that agents speed up typing, not delivery: review becomes the bottleneck. Budget for review capacity and measure finished work, not lines of code. Working paper, not yet peer reviewed.
title: Harvard study: coding agents add 30% more code, not more finished work
